summary: The most operationally significant development is the emergency landing of Flydubai flight FZ1073 in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, after a cockpit altercation and stabbing that was subdued by passengers, prompting a second Dubai-Tel Aviv flight to turn back. In parallel, the US State Department sanctioned multiple Iranian entities and individuals, offering a $15 million reward for information on IRGC commanders. Iranian leadership responded with threats to target regional oil infrastructure, coinciding with a maritime warning regarding a tanker struck by an unknown projectile in the Strait of Hormuz.
key_points: A Flydubai flight carrying 150 passengers, including 100 Israelis, made an emergency landing in Tabuk, Saudi Arabia, after a physical altercation in the cockpit where the co-pilot stabbed the main pilot, and passengers helped subdue the attacker. (Source: @lelotsenzura/94397)

The US State Department sanctioned eight entities and five individuals linked to the Iranian weapons program and offered a $15 million reward for information on IRGC Aerospace Force commanders. (Source: @rodast_omiddana/81723)

Iranian Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf threatened to attack US and regional oil infrastructure and tankers, stating that if Iran cannot sell oil, no one will, and no infrastructure will be safe. (Source: @VahidOnline/78560)

A second Flydubai flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv turned back mid-route to Dubai amid heightened aviation security concerns following the Tabuk emergency landing incident. (Source: @yediotnews25/135547)
UKMTO issued a maritime security warning and reported that an unknown projectile struck a crude oil tanker in the Strait of Hormuz, escalating regional tensions. (Source: @presstv/208926)

Hezbollah officially denied any link to a cell allegedly arrested by Syrian authorities in the Yarmouk basin, accusing Israel of attempting to inflame tensions between Lebanon and Syria. (Source: @naya_foriraq/92083)
An Israeli strike targeted a minibus in Gaza City, resulting in at least four Palestinian fatalities. (Source: @manniefabian/59284)
The IDF Chief of Staff held an emergency assessment with senior military commanders regarding the regional security situation and aviation incidents. (Source: @manniefabian/59283)
